en: What was that noise?
Oh God, no, please don't hurt me!
I'm gonna die, I'm gonna die!

No we... we'll laugh about it later.
You'll see.
If it starts to go bad, we're going to run, right?

Stop it!
I can barely stand as it is!

I'm... sure we have a plan, right?
Anybody?

They're too strong!
We have to run!
This can't be happening!

Just throw us on a boat and dump us here? How can they even be allowed to do this to us? Does anybody at home even know what they're doing, what kind of place this is? Can't I just wake up and have this all be just a bad dream?
You want me to leave? Okay, just please don't hurt me!
I can't believe what a mess this is.
I... I don't know how much more of this I can take.
I'm going.
Stop! Please, don't hurt me!
I don't have anything to give you!  You're going to kill me aren't you? Oh god, get away from me!
Yes of course, just don't hurt me!
No, please, anything but that!
Fine, anything you want!
Oh thank you! I'll go right away!
Sure, alright. Just... lead the way and I'll be right behind you.
I haven't spoken to anybody since I got here. Everyone just wants to rob me or rape me or worse. Please... you're making me really nervous. Can't you just leave me be?
Get back! I don't want any trouble!
You... want me to go with you? You'll keep me safe?
Please leave me alone! Please!

You know, I don't understand why I'm still here. I'm not strong, I'm not useful, but you keep me around anyway. You must have an awfully big heart to spare so much pity for a miserable thing like me. I would never have survived this long without you, so I just wanted to say thank you. You give me hope that maybe I'll somehow make it through all this. Here. It's not much of a gift, but it's the only thing I have of any value. Take it, please.

Hello. I'm doing well, I think. When I took a moment to calm down and look around, and saw all the others working together, it made me feel a lot better. If people as dangerous as this can work together for our shared survival, then maybe there's hope for me after all. I'll do my best.
You think that I should go? I don't really want to go anymore. Are you sure?
Just take it one day at a time.
Thank you. I would hate to leave now that I'm finally starting to find my place here.
You showed me that I'm strong enough to get by, even with my doubts, so I thank you for that. Goodbye.
I was just thinking it's a little dry in here!
Well it's about damn time.
Oh good, toys.
Waste of time messing with this shit.
You're dead meat!
You rancid whore!
Can we just get a fucking move on?
Someone's been here.
This is gonna be bloody as fuck!

You can kill me, I know you can.
Bring it on!

Aw, cheer up.
You got a front seat to the slaughter!

Oh don't worry.
I'll kill 'em extra dead, just for you!
Get out of the way, you damn pussy!

What the fuck do you know,
you whinging brat?

Hah!
Shit, that's messy!
Is that all you got?

Look, I know we gotta eat and sleep and wash our fucking socks and shit, but this sitting still is driving me nuts. They keep sending me out to hunt for meat, which is fine, but I want to kill something that understands what's going on when I crush its fucking windpipe. Take me with you to the next fight.
So what you're saying is that you're too fucking spineless to handle me, have I got that right?
What do you want?
Oh really? Prove it then! Lead me to the next slaughter.
I might've known. I know better than to start shit when I'm surrounded, but If I ever see you again, I'll kill you.
Haha, alright. My life is clearly in your hands. What will you do with it?
Will you still want it when it's soaked in blood? Come and get it asshole!
The strong take what they want, and you have beaten me. Take it.
I'll kill you the moment you turn your back! How does that sound?
Fine then. Lead me to the next fight.
Alright then.
I can already smell the blood. What are we waiting for?
I'm not interested in chitchat. If you aren't going to start a fight, I suggest you shove off before I decide to start one for you.
Come at me, asshole. I dare you.
Follow you? Sure. You lead me to the fight and I'll kill for you, as long as you let me kill the way I want.
Fucking spineless dog. Get out of my sight.

When we met I thought you were a goddamn pussy, and I only joined you because I was bored and didn't give a shit, but some of the bloodiest fights of my career have been fought right here, in your group. Nothing in the world is more exquisite. The blood, the screams, the gaze of eyes losing their grip on life. Everything on this island fears my name, or will learn to. Here. Think of it as a trophy. And don't you ever get on my bad side.

You know, I can't really sleep if I haven't killed recently. I see how easy it is to destroy life, and that's the only way to get any satisfaction out of being alive myself. Since being here with you though, I sleep good. I sleep real good. When's the next raid?
You better not be telling me to piss off, or you'll find yourself on the wrong side next time we meet. Is that what you want?
I can still smell it. It's fucking everywhere!
Then you're smarter than you look. You keep pointing and I'll keep killing. No reason to make things complicated.
I look forward to the day I get to snap your pretty little neck in my bare hands.
This will be simple.
Nothing to worry about.
Something here.
What is that?
A shame.
You will be missed.
Seems safe, for now.
Nothing to report.

Hmm.
This will be complicated.
This does not look good.

Don't worry.
We can do this.

We've done worse.
Focus.

Your judgement is poor.
We can win.

You are wrong.
Just watch.
That's inconvenient.
Now we're shorthanded.
Is there something you need?
You're certain?
Hello.
I remain then.
Farewell then.
You win!
No, that's mine!
A trade then. Take it.
I am no slave!
Very well, I will serve.
Fine. I go.
Then we go together.
Speak or begone.
What?
If you share supplies, I will join.
Then I refuse. Leave.
My turn for watch. Before you go, take this. It is my thanks.
What do you need?
You want me gone?
Ah, hello.
Then I will stay.
I go alone then.

Oh goodness!
They... they're weak, right?

Okay, we'll be fine.
We'll be fine.

Do... you think it's smart for us
to be playing with that?
I wonder if that's a good idea.
Not you!
I can't... I can't!

Oh goodness.
Did you hear something?
This place makes me so nervous.

Why... why are you making that face?
Are we going to die?

Oh God, that's more than we
can handle, isn't it? It is!

No, no, we'll be okay, right?
We've always been okay before...

It... should be fine.
We'll think of something!
We're all dead, I just know it!
Why, why does it have to end like this?
I'm gonna die here...
I can't breathe...

I thought I saw a monster outside the entrance just a moment ago, but nobody else saw it. Maybe it was just my imagination. I really don't like monsters, so I hope I was just seeing things. 
Anyway, did you need me?
Oh, uhm... okay, I'll get my things and leave.
Oh! You startled me. Did... you need something?
No? Well... alright I'll stay for now then.
Goodbye then.
No, please!  I've had enough!
I don't want to fight for this but.. I will if I must!
Yes, just let me go and it's yours!
You'll spare me now so you can work me to death later? I.. I won't!
Fine, whatever you say! I'll do whatever you want.
I won't get in your way again. Thank you!
This place is so awful... I still don't trust you, but I suppose I can follow you for a while and see how it goes.

I haven't met a single person since I've been here who hasn't tried to slip a knife in my ribs. I'm sorry if you're the rare nice one, but I just can't take any chances. If you have nothing to say to me, just please go away!
Please just stay back. I don't want any trouble.
Wait, what? You want me to join up with you? That... can't be right. I'm so useless. You're not serious, are you?
This conversation is making me really uncomfortable. Please just go.

Another quiet night? It's good to have those again. I can't believe what a mess I got into, getting shipped out here like this, being forced to fight just to survive. I thought I'd die starving and alone in some old burned-out basement. If I hadn't met you, I probably would have. 
I know our meeting was awkward, but I'm glad you came along when you did. Thank you. This isn't much, but I'd like you to have it.

I don't really know where this is all going or just how it's going to end up, but lately I've had the feeling that we're going to be alright. I mean, as alright as you can get while being stuck on an island like this one. I was quite terrified of some of the other people here, but I have to admit it's working out well enough so far.
Out there... by myself? But I'll die!
Hello. Is there something you need?
Thank you. I'll do whatever you need, just please don't make me go out there alone!

You wanna fight?
Cuz I do!

Little on the weak side,
but a fight's a fight!
Maybe some loot or somethin'?
Wonder what that's for.
Oh, you are gonna pay for that!
Pick on someone your own size, asshole!
Nothin' movin' over this way.
I got a weird feeling about this place.
Ah shit, we really stepped in it this time.

Bear down guys,
this one's gonna hurt.

What's a few bruises?
Show 'em what we got!
What, you don't really think this'll stop us?

Just lay down and die then!
I ain't goin' out yet!
Shut up and hurt something!
Yeah yeah, brokenhearted and shit.
Can't really find a fuck to give, buddy.
It's nice being able to get enough sleep for once, but it is really hard not to punch some of the people you're keeping on here. I need some action, so take me along for the next outing, alright?
Ah shit, really? Was it something I said?
Are we going out? I get antsy just sitting around here all day.
Hah, I knew you liked me! Come on, let's go clobber something!
Ah well, it was nice while it lasted. Thanks for the grub.
Gah, you win! Finish me already!
You want it? Come and get it!
Take it then, and let me go!
If you think you can tame me, let's see you fucking try!
If you're strong enough to beat me, I'm better off on your side anyway. It's a deal.
You're letting me walk? Hmph.
Well shit, show me who to punch!
What the hell do you want with me anyway? I already warned you. I'm real good at hurting people, so if you don't want to get hurt, you'd best back off and just leave me alone.
Keep your distance if you don't want me to hurt you.
You actually WANT me to hurt someone? And you'll like... share your food with me and stuff?
All talk huh?  Now I kinda feel like punching you, so you'd best screw off.

You might've pieced this together, but I like to fight. I've fought most of my life. I'm real good at it, but it's also the only thing I got. Makes a big difference when you can fight with someone decent covering your ass, so I gotta thank you for that. You put me through some of the roughest fights I've ever seen, and I wouldn't have it any other way. Here, this is for you. It's just my way of saying thanks.

You need me for anything? I could use a little exercise. I get really goddamn bored sitting around guarding the base, so I'd much rather go out with you and help you break some heads. Always a good time.
What? You need me though, don't you? I mean, I thought we were... you seriously want me to just leave?
Hey, I'm bored. Wanna wrestle? No? Maybe later.
Well don't scare me like that! I don't want to leave.
I really respect you, and that is the only thing that is keeping me from punching your lights out right now.  Get out of my way.
This arrangement seems good so far.
You want me to leave?
Hello ally.
Then I shall remain for now.
Fine, I will go. Goodbye.
You have beaten me. What is your intention?
I don't think so. You'll have to wrest it from my corpse.
Fine. I trade this for my life.
I'd sooner die than serve you.
Very well, I will join you.
I will leave then.
Do you want something?
Hello stranger.
Yes, I will join you, if you accept my terms.
If you cannot accept my terms, I cannot join you.
You have honoured our deal, and I thank you. This is a gift for you.
I am pleased to be here.
Hello friend.
Carry the food, carry the loot, I don't care. Load me up and let's go.
Did you need me for something?
Right behind you.

What a charming... place... you've put together here, and I would know. You can tell by just looking at me that I have impeccable taste, not to mention my credentials. That's why merchants are in such a good mood while I'm around, of course.
Oh hello!
Naturally. You keep the gears turning, and I'll keep everything well-oiled.

You know, it's a good thing I am here, or every passing merchant would swindle you for your last quarter! You can trust me, of course. More gold for you means more gold for the stronghold, and what's good for the stronghold is good for all of us!
Greetings to you!
I'll stay on top of those slippery vendors, don't you worry!
No doubt you come to see me because you've heard tales of my wondrous brew! You want someone turned into a toad, or wounds magically healed? I can do these things, and much more!
Well hello there, Deary. Come to visit your Nan, have you?
I won't be staying on long, Deary, so buy what you need while you can!

You know, I hear all kinds of interesting things here. People trust the man who pours the drinks, so I make sure everyone gets their fair share. If you want to leave any stuff for me to keep tucked away, or to sell off for coin, just put it there and I'll take care of it.
Sit down for a spell.
Don't go gettin' yourself killed, now.
I am right behind you.
I ain't scared! I ain't!
Let me take a look.
Want me to take care of that?
We got a man down!
Don't just stand there!
Feels good to be walkin' around.
Hear that? Guess I'm just jumpy.
It's the fish all over again!
I'm ready to die.
We'll come through, you'll see!
The boss will take 'em!
Quit your blubberin' and fight!
Don't be so damn stupid.
Step it up, or that's all of us!
That looked like it hurt.

Ugh, I still can't get the fish smell out of my beard. Still, there'd be worse in it if you hadn't come along when you did. I don't care what you did to end up here, you saved me and that's worth something, so I'm with you. Whatever you need.
Are you sure? I mean, are you going to be able to hold this place together without me?
Hey, good to see you! Everything going well today, I hope?
I won't hear it. I still owe you for saving my life, and I'll find some way to be of use, you'll see.
It's a shame I didn't get a chance to pay you back proper for what you did, but I won't argue. Try not to get yourself killed, alright?
What the fuck are you trying to do? Are you crazy?
In case you didn't notice, I don't have shit all! If you're going to kill me just get it over with!
Take it, I'm gone!
After seing how you treat people, I don't think so! Fuck you!
You could've just said so, you fucking psycho!
Why didn't you goddamn say so? Fuck.
Well, this day is lookin' up! I'll be right behind you. Need me to carry a torch or anything?

Me and a few others ended up stuck in the cliffs when the boat they pushed us in on went off course. Sahaguin rounded us up and put us in this cell. The others were all dragged off. Drowned and diced up for fish food no doubt. There's a lot of ways to die, and almost any of 'em are better than that.
Thanks so much. I ain't got much to offer, but I'd at least like to shake your hand.
Really? I mean, I'm in your debt for sure, and it ain't like I got anywhere else to be. I ain't much of a fighter, but I'll help out however I can.
You saved my life, and I well know it. I'll bugger off once I catch my breath and scavenge what I can from this camp.

A stupid deer. That was what got me sent here, you know? 

I hunted in the forest back home for years. I mean, sure I knew it was poaching, but I never figured it mattered. 

Not like the duke could eat every deer, right? 

I did it for so long I hardly even thought about it. 

|Well one day I'm out with my bow and I bag this monster stag. You should've seen the rack on it! 

Turns out though, I wasn't the only one out for a hunt. Me up to my elbows in deer guts and who comes riding along but old twirly-tits himself, and a half dozen sidekicks besides. 

He nearly shot me dead right there, but one of his hounds convinced him it would be more fitting to have me shipped out here. 

I didn't think he could really make it happen, but here I am. 

|So ends the story of Bato. 

At least, that's how I thought it ended, before you came along and hauled my ass out of the brine. 

Because of you, I get a chance to write a better ending, and I will never, ever forget. 

I am your man, and glad about it.

Seems like forever ago we were crawling through that damned cave together. I never thought of myself as much of an adventurer you know, but this? After staring fishy death in the face, I am having more fun than I ever did. We got something good here, and it's thanks to you.
Wait, what? After all my hard work I get the boot?
Everything's in order here. Got something on your mind?
I know I ain't as tough as some of these fuckers, but I do more to keep this place in order than you might think. Please trust me.
Alright, fine. You're the boss, and I don't owe you nothin' anymore.
I haven't forgotten how to fight!
Some things never change.
Is this important?
Something's there.
We're losing numbers!
Man down!
Ort.
I could do with a sit down.

Come then. 
I am already dead.
I'll drag you down with me!

Keep a cool head,
and we will win!
Get into position!

Quiet, soldier!
Form up!

Either form up, 
or fall back!
This isn't going well.
Press the advantage!
I am well-used to living like this, moving from holdout to holdout, fighting skirmishes, rationing supplies. If not for the utter ruin of this place, I could believe that nothing has changed.
